text.p: NOTE: CIT Group Holdings Inc is 80 percent owned by Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd and 20 percent by Chase Manhattan Corp.
Return on average financing and leasing assets for the first quarter of 1997 was 1.60 percent, up from 1.49 percent for 1996.

Earnings assets, primarily comprised of finance receivables, operating lease equipment and consumer finance receivables held for sale, totaled $19.1 billion at March 31, 1997, up 2.9 percent from $18.6 billion at year end 1996.
Fees and other income totaled $57.7 million in the first quarter of 1997, up from $52.7 million in 1996.

Net credit losses during the first quarter of 1997 were $25.7 million, 0.60 percent of average finance receivables, compared with $25.4 million, 0.64 percent of average finance receivables for the first quarter of 1996.
